attributes.title: [SRE] AppHub → Meridium latency
attributes.description: Client-side latency from AppHub to APM Classic / Meridium ingress. Vega charts auto-bucket with the time picker. Default last 3 days.

AppHub proxies HTTPS to APM Classic / Meridium hosts (`classic-stage`, `classic-dev`, `classic-beta`, `meridium-ui`). It does **not** call `meridium-webapi` by service name. Change the **time picker** — line charts and the heatmap re-bucket automatically (last 15m vs last 3d). Click a **legend** item to isolate a host.

- **P2** avg ≥ **500 ms**
- **P1** fail share ≥ **5%**
- **P1** ≥3 client spans lasting **≥30 s**
